results.content: Once logged in, you will be presented with your current loans, giving you details of the books you have borrowed from the library and when they should be renewed or returned. * You will be able to describe and explain why the Berlin Wall was built in 1961. * You will be able to explain the impact the building of the wall had on East-West relations and the importance of Kennedy’s visit to Berlin in 1963. * You will be able to show a good understanding of the Cuban Revolution of 1959, the importance of the Bay of Pigs failed invasion of 1961 and the events of the Cuban Missile Crisis of October 1962. * You will be able to precisely recall details of how why the Berlin Wall was built in 1961. * You will be able to evaluate the importance of the building of the wall on East-West relations and the importance of Kennedy’s visit to Berlin in 1963.
